title: THE LAST LIGHT OF PORTUS — A ROMAN HARBOR STORY
subtitle: A fictional Roman harbor drama at twilight; stylized 2D reconstruction, not a documented historical incident.

beats.text: A merchant ship was heading straight for the rocks.
Aelia grabbed the last burning lantern.
She ran for the tower. Felix caught the rope.
The wind nearly pulled it from her hands.
Together, they raised the flame above the storm.
Its glow showed the sailors a safe way home.
